atoms.text: Rocco’s friends are throwing him a surprise birthday party.

instruction.text: Read and follow along with the conversation.

atoms.b: Frank, shhh, Rocco arrives any minute!

atoms.b: Oh, I am so excited, Rocco is going to love this surprise!
atoms.sound: ssml:Oh, I am so excited, Rocco is going to love this surprise! <break time='500ms'/> <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom' gain='1'>door_opening01</voice>

atoms.b: Ahh! You guys really surprised me!
atoms.sound: ssml: Ahh! You guys really surprised me!<break time='500ms'/>

feedback.end: That’s right, Rocco is feeling surprised. He had no idea that all his friends would be waiting for him. When he walked through the door, they popped up and gave him a fright!

atoms.text:
Sometimes it can be hard to tell fear and surprise apart. Surprise can be scary, but it usually goes away quickly.

Some people like surprises and others don’t. Do you like to feel surprised?

instruction.text: Find different parts of Rocco to see how he and others can experience surprise.

feedback.end: When people feel surprised, their face usually shows it! Many people’s eyes get very large, and their eyebrows go up.
Many people open their mouths when they are surprised.
Being surprised makes your heart beat fast! It can take a while for it to slow back down.
Surprise can mean you throw your hands in the air, almost like you are trying to hold something away from you.
Some people’s tummies feel light and jittery like butterflies. Others’ tummies feel heavy, like a brick is at the bottom.

atoms.text:
Everyone has been surprised at some point in their life. Some surprises are better than others.

In the end, Rocco was glad his friends surprised him. However, Rocco probably wouldn’t want a nasty surprise, like finding a spider in his bed!
